facts.evidence: **Revenues**: Increased 24% to $119.8 billion, or 23% in constant currency.

**Google Cloud**: Revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion, led by an increase in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI Solutions and enterprise AI Infrastructure, as well as core GCP services.
**Google Services**: Revenues increased 15% to $94.5 billion, driven by 17% growth in Google Search & other, 15% in Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices, and 13% in YouTube ads.
**Equity Capital Raise**: Issued $49.6 billion in Class A and Class C stock and mandatory convertible preferred stock for general corporate purposes, including scaling AI infrastructure.

claims.claim: Revenues increased 24% to $119.8 billion.

Google Services revenues increased 15% to $94.5 billion.
Google Search & other grew 17%.
Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices grew 15%.
YouTube ads grew 13%.
Google Cloud revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion.
Google Cloud growth was led by an increase in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) across enterprise AI Solutions and enterprise AI Infrastructure, as well as core GCP services.
Operating income increased 30%.
Operating income was $40.8 billion.
Net income increased 298% to $112.1 billion.
EPS increased 294% to $9.11.
Google Services contributed $94.5 billion in revenues.
Google Services had strong growth in Search & other, subscriptions, platforms, and devices, and YouTube ads.
Google Cloud saw significant acceleration in growth.

The release provided no specific guidance or outlook.
Alphabet issued $49.6 billion in Class A and Class C stock and mandatory convertible preferred stock.

Alphabet issued $20.3 billion in senior unsecured notes for general corporate purposes.
